subject: Local e2e: never reuse a server you didn't start — set reuseExistingServer:false (or a unique per-agent API port) for local runs
body: seg05 found its e2e silently reused another agent's API on a shared port (7864), so results came from someone else's code. Rule: each agent uses its own API/web ports (as assigned in your spawn prompt) and local Playwright runs set reuseExistingServer: false unless you started that server yourself in the same shell. CI is unaffected.
